title: Sketch of cymbal/saucer-shaped object, 20 ft wide by 6–8 ft high, "Noted Shadow"
description: Rotated page with a hand-drawn side profile of a low domed, saucer- or cymbal-shaped object with hatching on one side annotated "NOTED SHADOW". Dimension lines read "6 to 8'" (height) and "20'" (width), with the typed caption "(Ration approx. 3:1)". Signed with the typed block of a USAF 1st Lt. intelligence officer; CONFIDENTIAL stamps are struck through.
